title: Quantum circuits of elastic wave equations via Schrödingerisation
description_zh: 在 4 个分量比特上实现三维弹性波方程 Schrödinger 化后方向块 e^{iÃ₂t} 的精确线路：先用多控 R_y Givens 旋转（P_ℓ）变换法向应力子空间，再以多控 R_x 实现法向-速度与两个剪切-速度二能级旋转，最后逆变换。
description_en: Exact circuit on 4 component qubits for the directional block e^{iÃ₂t} of the Schrödingerised 3D elastic wave equation: multi-controlled R_y Givens rotations (P_ℓ) first transform the normal-stress subspace, multi-controlled R_x gates then implement the normal–velocity and the two shear–velocity two-level rotations, and the transformation is finally inverted.
params_source: pseudo-random (paper gives only formulas theta_2=atan2(m2,m1), theta_3=..., beta_P=-2 omega_d t, beta_S=-2 m3 t; numeric tests are 2D only)
verification: functional: with physically consistent m1=0.9,m2=0.55,m3=0.4,t=0.37 (angles from the paper formulas) the circuit unitary equals expm(i*A_2*t) on the full 16-dim space (9 used labels + invariant unused states) to 1e-15 up to global phase; same check passes for k=3 (l=1) and k=5 (l=3); gate-by-gate faithfulness also checked

title: Quantum Heuristic Separation of Comb Inequalities for the Travelling Salesman Problem
description_zh: 在 3 个数据比特和 4 个计数比特上，以受控 SWAP（Fredkin）级联把数据寄存器中 |1⟩ 的个数（汉明重量）编码为计数寄存器的独热态，是梳不等式分离算法中多控 E 门的分解。
description_en: On 3 data qubits and 4 counter qubits, a cascade of controlled-SWAP (Fredkin) gates encodes the number of |1⟩s in the data register (its Hamming weight) as a one-hot state of the counter register; this is the decomposition of the multi-controlled E gate in the comb-inequality separation algorithm.
verification: functional: for all 8 data inputs with Count=|0000>, Count ends in one-hot |e_w> with w = Hamming weight (0->1000,1->0100,2->0010,3->0001), probability 1; QASM unitary equals the raw diagram circuit

title: Quantum Fokker-Planck solvers as trainable generative models
description_zh: 在 4 个标志比特、1 个辅助比特 p 和 sgn 比特上实现 QSVT 相位门 Φ_k：用 4 重开控 Toffoli 在成功子空间翻转 p，施加 R_ZZ(2φ_k) 后反计算，使 sgn=0/1 分别获得 ±φ_k 相位。
description_en: QSVT phase gate Φ_k on 4 flag qubits, 1 ancilla p and the sgn qubit: a 4-fold open-controlled Toffoli flips p in the success subspace, R_ZZ(2φ_k) is applied and the flip is uncomputed, so that sgn=0/1 acquire the phases ±φ_k respectively.
params_source: pseudo-random (QSVT phases are trained, paper gives no values)
verification: functional: unitary is diagonal with phase exp(-i phi_k Z_p Z_sgn) where p is flipped iff all four flags are 0; on the success subspace sgn=0 gets +phi_k and sgn=1 gets -phi_k (relative), as the caption states

title: Normal-Form Characterization of Adaptivity and Entanglement in Pauli-Based Computation
description_zh: 在 4 个比特上求解一个 Deutsch–Jozsa 问题实例的 Clifford+T 线路：Hadamard 层后接由 7 个 T 门分解的 Toffoli 与一个 CNOT 组成的平衡函数 oracle，再做 Hadamard。
description_en: Clifford+T circuit solving a Deutsch–Jozsa problem instance on 4 qubits: a Hadamard layer, then a balanced-function oracle made of a Toffoli decomposed with 7 T gates and one CNOT, then Hadamards again.
verification: counts: n=4, T-count 7, CX count 7, matching the paper table (Deutsch-Josza_n4: n=4, t=7, CX=7). functional: equals panel (a) (X on ancilla, H^4, CCX(q1,q2;q3), CX(q0;q3), H^3) as an operator; measured qubit y1 is 1 with probability 1 (balanced) as the text states

title: Digital Quantum Simulation of Dynamics in Interacting Fields
description_zh: 在 5 个比特上用最近邻 CNOT 阶梯实现 Φ²₅(θ)：依次构造各比特对的奇偶并施加 R_Z，从而一次性实现全部 10 个两体 R_ZZ(θ_ab) 旋转。
description_en: Φ²₅(θ) on 5 qubits implemented with nearest-neighbour CNOT ladders: the parity of each qubit pair is formed in turn and an R_Z is applied, realising all 10 two-body R_ZZ(θ_ab) rotations in a single pass.
params_source: pseudo-random (theta_ab depend on field coefficients and time step; no numeric values given)
verification: functional: unitary equals prod_{a<b} RZZ(theta_ab) on qubits (a,b) exactly (20 cx, 10 rz)

title: CO$Φ$ - COmpiling PHotonics into dIgital quantum circuits
description_zh: 在两模截断光子编码（4 比特）上实现优化分束器中的 V_even 块：受控 Y 与 R_x 基变换夹着两组 R_y(ξ±)–CNOT 均匀受控旋转，作用于偶光子数扇区（U₂、U₄）。
description_en: V_even block of the optimised beam splitter in a two-mode truncated photon encoding (4 qubits): two groups of R_y(ξ±)–CNOT uniformly controlled rotations sandwiched between controlled-Y and R_x basis changes, acting on the even-photon-number sectors (U₂, U₄).
params_source: paper relation xi_+- = -(sqrt3 +- 1)/2 * theta applied to the pseudo-random theta=-2.079028 used for k=29/k=20
verification: functional: same assembled-BS check as k=29 (exact equality with (+)U_n, so V_even reproduces the U_2 and U_4 sectors)

title: CO$Φ$ - COmpiling PHotonics into dIgital quantum circuits
description_zh: 在两模截断光子编码（4 比特）上实现优化分束器中的 V_odd 块：由 R_x 基变换、受控 Y 门和受控 R_y(−2θ)、R_y(−4θ) 组成，作用于奇光子数扇区（U₁、U₃、U₅）。
description_en: V_odd block of the optimised beam splitter in a two-mode truncated photon encoding (4 qubits): composed of R_x basis changes, controlled-Y gates and controlled R_y(−2θ), R_y(−4θ) rotations, acting on the odd-photon-number sectors (U₁, U₃, U₅).
verification: functional: assembling the paper optimized BS circuit (outer CNOTs, M=(S x S)(I x H)CX gates from the U_3 figure, this V_odd and k=30 V_even with xi_+-=-(sqrt3+-1)/2 theta) gives exactly the paper block-diagonal U_BS = (+)_{n=0..6} U_n (error 9e-16); also full-count check: whole BS has 22 CNOT + 6 CY as stated

title: CO$Φ$ - COmpiling PHotonics into dIgital quantum circuits
description_zh: 在两模光子各截断为 4 能级（每模 2 比特）的编码下，实现分束器单光子扇区 U₁ 的线路：CNOT 基变换后施加开/闭混合三控 R_y(2θ)，只在 {|0,1⟩,|1,0⟩} 子空间做旋转。
description_en: Circuit for the single-photon sector U₁ of a beam splitter with both photon modes truncated to 4 levels (2 qubits per mode): after a CNOT basis change, a triply controlled R_y(2θ) with mixed open/closed controls rotates only within the {|0,1⟩,|1,0⟩} subspace.
params_source: pseudo-random (theta is the beam-splitter angle; no fixed value)
verification: functional: unitary equals [[cos t,-sin t],[sin t,cos t]] on {|0001>,|0100>} and identity elsewhere (paper U_1, error 4e-16)

title: Real-time quantum simulation of hadron production in deep inelastic scattering
description_zh: 在 6 个比特上制备 SU(3) 色单态的态制备线路：先用 R_y(θ₁)、受控 R_y(π/2) 和开控 Toffoli 在夸克寄存器上制备 W₃ 态，再用 CNOT 与反夸克寄存器纠缠。
description_en: State-preparation circuit for an SU(3) colour singlet on 6 qubits: R_y(θ₁), a controlled R_y(π/2) and an open-controlled Toffoli first prepare a W₃ state on the quark register, which CNOTs then entangle with the antiquark register.
verification: functional: probabilities 1/3 on |001001>,|010010>,|100100> (qiskit little-endian), as the caption describes

title: Margin-Based Generalization for Quantum Machine Learning with Classical Data Encoding
description_zh: 在 4 个比特上实现一层 IQP 数据编码：先对各比特施加 H 与 R_Z(x_i)，再在相邻比特对上施加 R_ZZ(x_i x_{i+1})。
description_en: One layer of IQP data encoding on 4 qubits: H and R_Z(x_i) on each qubit, followed by R_ZZ(x_i x_{i+1}) on neighbouring qubit pairs.
params_source: pseudo-random (x is the classical data input)
verification: functional: output state has fidelity 1 with (1/4) sum_z exp(-i/2 [sum x_i z_i + sum x_i x_{i+1} z_i z_{i+1}]) |z>

title: Time-Domain Observables for Resonant Scattering in Quantum Simulations of Lattice Gauge Theory
description_zh: 在 3 个比特上实现 SU(3) 胶球玩具模型相互作用项 e^{-iθ(|010⟩⟨101|+h.c.)} 的线路：先用两个 CNOT 做基映射，再以两个 RCCX（相对相位 Toffoli）与单比特旋转实现双控 R_x 的 Givens 旋转，最后逆映射。
description_en: Circuit on 3 qubits for the interaction term e^{-iθ(|010⟩⟨101|+h.c.)} of an SU(3) glueball toy model: two CNOTs perform a basis mapping, two RCCX (relative-phase Toffoli) gates together with single-qubit rotations implement a doubly controlled R_x Givens rotation, and the mapping is then inverted.
params_source: derived from paper: theta = alpha_2 * dtau with alpha_2 = 2 (toy-model parameters {alpha1,alpha2,eps+,epse} = {-1.2,2,5.33,10.80}) and dtau = 0.025 (Fig. dt=0.025 caption); paper does not state theta explicitly (second-order Trotter could halve it)
verification: functional: final QASM unitary equals expm(-i*0.05*(|010><101|+|101><010|)) (qiskit index 2<->5) with |Tr(V^dag U)|/8 = 1.0000 (exact up to global phase; the high-level k=2 version gives the same); counts: 10 CX, matching the caption's 'at most 10 RZZ' (each CX ~ one RZZ(pi/2))

title: Large-Scale Benchmarking of Quantum Neural Network Configurations for Financial Time Series Forecasting
description_zh: 4 比特量子神经网络线路：先用 H 与 R_Y 做角度编码，再施加一层全连接的受控 R_X 拟设（12 个 CRX，覆盖所有有序比特对）。
description_en: 4-qubit quantum neural network circuit: angle encoding with H and R_Y, followed by one fully connected layer of controlled-R_X ansatz gates (12 CRX gates covering all ordered qubit pairs).
params_source: pseudo-random (rotations drawn without angles; encoding angles are data-dependent, trainable angles not given)
verification: functional: final QASM Operator equals an independently built H/RY + 12-CRX circuit with the same pair order (Operator.equiv True) | counts: 12 CRX = 4*3 ordered pairs, consistent with all-to-all ansatz (c) | faithfulness checked

title: A Cognitive-Aware QML-CRL Framework for Detecting Affinity and Romance-Investment Fraud
description_zh: 欺诈检测量子认知编码器的读出块：先在框架比特 q4 上做可训练 RY(μ) 基变换，再用五个受控 RY(φ_j) 把各偏置比特 q0–q4 的信息聚合到叙事比特 q5 上。
description_en: Readout block of the quantum cognitive encoder for fraud detection: a trainable RY(μ) basis change on the frame qubit q4, then five controlled RY(φ_j) gates that aggregate the information of the bias qubits q0–q4 onto the narrative qubit q5.
params_source: pseudo-random (trainable parameters; paper gives no trained values)
verification: functional: with q0..q4 prepared by random RY angles, simulated <Z_5> = -0.79893143 equals the paper's formula Re prod_j(1+p_j(e^{i phi_j}-1)) = -0.79893143 (p_4 including the RY(mu) readout rotation)

title: A Practical Introduction to VQE: Methods, Challenges, and Applications in Physics and Chemistry
description_zh: 为 6 格点 Hubbard 链（12 个 JW 比特，前 6 个自旋向上、后 6 个自旋向下）制备“配对-自旋”初态：每对相邻格点处于 (|↑↓⟩+|↓↑⟩)/√2 叠加，保证半填充且 S_z=0。
description_en: Prepares the "pair-spin" initial state of a 6-site Hubbard chain (12 Jordan–Wigner qubits, the first 6 spin-up and the last 6 spin-down): each pair of neighbouring sites is in the superposition (|↑↓⟩+|↓↑⟩)/√2, which guarantees half filling and S_z=0.
verification: functional: statevector has exactly 8 equal-amplitude (1/8 probability, equal phase) terms; in every term each site pair (2i,2i+1), i=0,1,2, holds one spin-up and one spin-down electron on different sites, i.e. prod_i (|up_2i dn_2i+1> + |dn_2i up_2i+1>)/sqrt2 as stated in the text

title: Efficient Fidelity Estimation of General Quantum Resource States via Clifford Circuits
description_zh: Bell–相干保真度估计（BCFE）的 Bell 部分：在两组 3 比特上各制备一份 CZ 连接的 RZ(α_jθ)|+⟩ 资源态，再用横向 CNOT 与 H 做逐对 Bell 测量以估计反对称（单态）事件概率。
description_en: Bell part of Bell–coherence fidelity estimation (BCFE): each of two 3-qubit groups prepares a copy of the CZ-connected resource state built from RZ(α_jθ)|+⟩, and transversal CNOTs and H gates then perform pairwise Bell measurements to estimate the probability of antisymmetric (singlet) events.
params_source: paper: eq. multiqubit-simulation-target (alpha=(1,1.4,1.8)); theta/pi=0.03 is the fixed angle used in the Fig. multiqubit-scaling sweep (one of the simulated angles 0.01..0.05 pi)
verification: functional: final QASM operator-equals two copies of the paper's eq. (CZ_23 CZ_12 prod R_Z(alpha_j theta)|+>) followed by the Bell measurement; for identical pure copies P(odd number of singlet outcomes) = 9e-33 (= (1-tr rho^2)/2 = 0 as stated); sanity with distinct copies gives P(odd)=0.138265 = (1-|<psi|phi>|^2)/2

title: JAQSI: Just Another Quantum Simulator
description_zh: JAQSI 脉冲级基准线路（n=3）：先在每个比特上作用 H 门，再施加首尾相接的 CRX(φ) 环（0→1、1→2、2→0）。
description_en: JAQSI pulse-level benchmark circuit (n=3): an H gate on every qubit, followed by a closed ring of CRX(φ) gates (0→1, 1→2, 2→0).
params_source: pseudo-random (paper draws angles uniformly from [-pi,pi] with an unstated seed; gives no values)
verification: functional: final QASM is operator-equivalent to H^{x3} followed by the CRX ring built from the paper's own CRX decomposition (fig:benchmark_circuit_crx: RZ(pi/2) RY(phi/2) CX RY(-phi/2) CX RZ(-pi/2)), and to qiskit's crx ring | counts: 2 CX per CRX as in that decomposition -> 6 CX total, consistent with the paper's pulse count 21n = 3*3 (H) + 3*18 (CRX) for n=3

title: Sum-of-squares compilation of matrix-model dynamics for NISQ and fault-tolerant hardware
description_zh: 相位梯度注入线路：用 Cuccaro 加法器把 2 比特数值寄存器 V（零扩展到 3 比特）加到 3 比特催化相位梯度寄存器 |γ_L⟩ 上，从而施加相位 e^{−2πiV/2^L} 且 |γ_L⟩ 与辅助比特保持不变。
description_en: Phase-gradient injection circuit: a Cuccaro adder adds the 2-qubit value register V (zero-extended to 3 qubits) into the 3-qubit catalytic phase-gradient register |γ_L⟩, thereby applying the phase e^{−2πiV/2^L} while leaving |γ_L⟩ and the ancilla unchanged.
verification: functional: classical truth table gamma -> gamma+V mod 8 with V, zero-extension bit and carry restored for all 32 inputs; with gamma = sum_k e^{2 pi i k/8}|k>/sqrt8 the output equals e^{-2 pi i V/8}|V>|gamma> for V=0..3, as stated in the caption | counts: 12 CX, 6 CCX match the source comment

title: Sum-of-squares compilation of matrix-model dynamics for NISQ and fault-tolerant hardware
description_zh: 对 3 比特整数 n 编码的奇数 m=2n−7 计算绝对值 |m| 的可逆线路：用临时比特保存 ¬MSB(n)，把 n 的低位上移一位并按符号条件取反写入输出寄存器，最低位恒置 1，最后恢复临时比特。
description_en: Reversible circuit computing the absolute value |m| of the odd number m=2n−7 encoded by a 3-bit integer n: a temporary qubit stores ¬MSB(n), the low bits of n are shifted up by one position and conditionally negated according to the sign as they are written into the output register, the least significant bit is always set to 1, and the temporary qubit is finally restored.
verification: functional: truth table over all 8 inputs gives |2n-7| in the bottom three wires (7,5,3,1,1,3,5,7), n unchanged and scratch restored to 0 | counts: 6 CNOT, 3 X, 0 AND as stated in the caption

title: Efficient Block Encoding of Structured Hamiltonians by Separating Where and What
description_zh: Anderson 杂质模型一体项的目标作用电路：在 CNOT 奇偶框架内，由标签比特受控地在两个目标比特上施加 X 与 Z，实现所选的 Pauli 项（XX/YY 跃迁或格点相位）。
description_en: Target-action circuit for the one-body terms of the Anderson impurity model: within a CNOT parity frame, label qubits control X and Z gates on two target qubits to implement the selected Pauli term (XX/YY hopping or on-site phase).
verification: functional: for all 16 control settings the target 4x4 block equals (X X)^{fT} Z_up^{fA^fAk0^fTy} Z_down^{fAk0^fTy} up to phase, exactly the exponents stated in the caption

title: Efficient Block Encoding of Structured Hamiltonians by Separating Where and What
description_zh: N=5 的互补对置换网络：5 个由地址位异或奇偶性控制的 CSWAP 先定向互补对 {1,2},{3,4}，再经两棵交换树把所选位点对 (j,j′) 分别搬到 q0 和 q1。
description_en: Complementary-pair permutation network for N=5: 5 CSWAPs controlled by XOR parities of the address bits first orient the complementary pairs {1,2},{3,4}, then two swap trees move the selected site pair (j,j′) to q0 and q1 respectively.
verification: functional: for all 10 pairs (j,j') with control rows set to the parities in the diagram labels (j2^j'2, j1^j'1^j'2, j'0^j'1^1, j1^j2, j0^j1), q_j ends on q0 and q_j' on q1 | counts: 5 CSWAPs as in caption

title: Efficient Block Encoding of Structured Hamiltonians by Separating Where and What
description_zh: 10 个叶子、4 位地址的受控交换树：9 个 CSWAP 按地址位逐层交换，把地址 a 选中的叶子比特内容搬到根（叶子 0），用于块编码 SELECT 的置换网络。
description_en: Controlled-swap tree with 10 leaves and a 4-bit address: 9 CSWAPs swap level by level according to the address bits, moving the content of the leaf qubit selected by address a to the root (leaf 0); used as the permutation network of a block-encoding SELECT.
verification: functional: for every address a=0..9 with a one-hot on leaf a, the final QASM puts the 1 on the root and leaves the address unchanged | counts: 9 CSWAPs (caption: "nine exchanges")

title: Unflattening by Flattening -- How Input Distributions Shape Output Variance in Angle-Encoded Circuits
description_zh: 4 比特非对角拟设的一层：在相邻比特对上依次施加 RXX 与 RYY 旋转（砖墙排列），李代数为 so(n)⊕so(n)，对计算基输入输出恒为零。
description_en: One layer of the 4-qubit off-diagonal ansatz: RXX and RYY rotations applied in turn on neighbouring qubit pairs (brickwork arrangement); its Lie algebra is so(n)⊕so(n), and its output is identically zero for computational-basis inputs.
params_source: pseudo-random (paper gives none; independent trainable angles)
verification: functional: <x|U^dag (X_iX_{i+1}+Y_iY_{i+1}) U|x> = 0 (max 3e-16) for all 16 computational-basis inputs and all bonds, the paper's zero-output claim; also Majorana-linear (matchgate subalgebra)

title: Unflattening by Flattening -- How Input Distributions Shape Output Variance in Angle-Encoded Circuits
description_zh: 4 比特匹配门（matchgate）拟设的一层：每个比特先做 RZ，再在相邻比特上施加砖墙式 RXX 旋转，其动力学李代数为 so(2n)。
description_en: One layer of the 4-qubit matchgate ansatz: an RZ on every qubit, followed by brickwork RXX rotations on neighbouring qubits; its dynamical Lie algebra is so(2n).
params_source: pseudo-random (paper gives none; independent trainable angles)
verification: functional: U commutes with Z^{x4} parity and conjugates every Majorana operator into the span of the 8 Majoranas (residual 3e-15), i.e. a matchgate / so(2n) circuit

title: Characterizing unitaries via quasi-process functions
description_zh: 在 3 个比特上实现 SHIFT 幺正：依次对 A、B、C 施加由另外两方（混合开/闭控制）控制的 Hadamard，将计算基映射为非纠缠量子非定域（QNLWE）的 SHIFT 积态基。
description_en: Implements the SHIFT unitary on 3 qubits: Hadamards on A, B and C in turn, each controlled by the other two parties (mixed open/closed controls), mapping the computational basis to the SHIFT product basis that exhibits quantum nonlocality without entanglement (QNLWE).
verification: functional: unitary maps the 8 computational basis states exactly (up to phase) onto the SHIFT basis {|000>,|111>,|±01>,|1±0>,|01±>} (e.g. |A0B0C1> -> |+01>, |A1B0C1> -> |-01>, |A1B0C0> -> |1+0>) as stated in the paper's B_S

title: Unifying and Extending Strong Simulation of Quantum Circuits
description_zh: 强模拟论文中张量压缩一节的 3 比特运行示例线路 C_3：依次施加 H 层、T 层、全对 CZ 层、H 层、全对 CZ 层和 H 层，用于展示分隔符对称性与相位系数张量压缩。
description_en: The 3-qubit running-example circuit C_3 from the tensor-compression section of the strong-simulation paper: an H layer, a T layer, an all-pairs CZ layer, an H layer, an all-pairs CZ layer and an H layer applied in sequence, used to illustrate separator symmetry and phase-coefficient tensor compression.
verification: functional: simulated <000|U|000> = 0.25+0.5i equals the paper's sum-product expression 2^{-3k/2} sum_{a,b} omega^{sum a_i + 4 sum a_i b_i + 4 sum_{i<j} a_i a_j + 4 sum_{i<j} b_i b_j} (omega=e^{i pi/4}, k=3) = 0.25+0.5i | counts: 9 H, 3 T, 6 CZ = 3k H, k T, 2*C(k,2) CZ as defined

title: Shock-Capturing Quantum Algorithm for the Linear Advection Operator
description_zh: 在 4 个数据比特上实现周期性平移算符 U⁺（|j⟩→|j+1 mod 16⟩）的线路：由控制数依次递减的多控 NOT 级联（C³X、C²X、CX、X）构成，用作迎风格式平流 LCU 算法中的选择算符。
description_en: Circuit for the periodic shift operator U⁺ (|j⟩→|j+1 mod 16⟩) on 4 data qubits: a cascade of multi-controlled NOTs with decreasing numbers of controls (C³X, C²X, CX, X), used as the select operator in the LCU algorithm for upwind-scheme advection.
verification: functional: Operator of the final QASM equals the cyclic shift permutation |j> -> |j+1 mod 16> exactly (qiskit little-endian, q0 = top wire), matching the paper's U^+ matrix

title: Rotation Collision based Quantum Lattice Boltzmann Methods
description_zh: D2Q5 格子玻尔兹曼模型的三比特 Shende–Bullock–Markov 振幅编码线路：用逐级（开/闭）受控 R_y 旋转把 5 个非负振幅写入 |000>…|100>，零填充分支省略。
description_en: Three-qubit Shende–Bullock–Markov amplitude-encoding circuit for the D2Q5 lattice Boltzmann model: cascaded (open/closed) controlled R_y rotations write 5 non-negative amplitudes into |000>…|100>, with the zero-padded branches omitted.
params_source: pseudo-random (angles depend on the prescribed velocity v and the instantaneous state; paper gives no numeric values)
verification: functional: re-converted with angles from the paper's eq. (sbm-angle) for the D2Q5 equilibrium direction sqrt(lambda_i) (w=(1/3,1/6,1/6,1/6,1/6), test v=(0.05,0.02)); prepared state equals the target 5-amplitude state on paper indices |0>..|4> (max abs error 2e-16) with zeros on |5>,|6>,|7>. Note: the formula gives th_{1,1}=0 for any 5-amplitude D2Q5 state; the final QASM keeps the converter's pseudo-random angles (nonzero th_{1,1})

title: Transversal Fanout for Fault Tolerant Distributed Quantum Computing: Analysis and Application
description_zh: 在 4 个节点共 16 个比特上实现全局受控 Z 门 GCZ₁₆：对所有 120 对比特两两施加 CZ，作为分布式扇出（fanout）实现的目标运算。
description_en: Global controlled-Z gate GCZ₁₆ on 16 qubits spread over 4 nodes: a CZ on every one of the 120 qubit pairs, the target operation of the distributed fanout implementation.
verification: counts: 120 CZ, exactly the 120 distinct pairs of 16 qubits, 96 of them inter-node, matching the paper's '120 CZs, of which 96 inter-node' | functional: on sampled basis states |x> the phase equals (-1)^C(|x|,2), as required for prod_(m<n) CZ

title: Quantum lattice Boltzmann method via density-matrix encoding for fluid simulation with wall boundary conditions
description_zh: D2Q4 格子气碰撞步线路：借助一个辅助比特，用 CNOT 与 Toffoli 交换速度占据态 |0101> 与 |1010>，其余基态不变，辅助比特还原为 |0>。
description_en: Collision-step circuit of a D2Q4 lattice gas: with the help of one ancilla qubit, CNOTs and Toffolis swap the velocity occupation states |0101> and |1010>, leave all other basis states unchanged, and return the ancilla to |0>.
verification: functional: on all 16 basis inputs |n0n1n2n3>|0>_a the final QASM maps |0101> <-> |1010>, leaves the other 14 states unchanged and returns the ancilla to |0> (probability 1), exactly as the caption states

title: Optimizing Atom Transport, Gate-Count and Depth with Parity Twine
description_zh: 在 5 比特线性近邻阵列上用 Parity Twine 网络实现的量子傅里叶变换 QFT₅：由逐级缩短的 DCNOT 链传播奇偶标签并穿插 R_Z/R_X 旋转，最后用 4 个 CNOT 解码恢复各比特标签。
description_en: Quantum Fourier transform QFT₅ implemented with a Parity Twine network on a 5-qubit linear nearest-neighbour array: progressively shorter DCNOT chains propagate parity labels, interleaved with R_Z/R_X rotations, and 4 final CNOTs decode the labels back to the individual qubits.
params_source: pseudo-random (paper omits all RZ and RX angles from the diagram)
verification: functional: with the diagram's exact gate structure, fitting the 25 rotation angles (BFGS) reproduces the 5-qubit QFT exactly (process fidelity 1 - 2e-15, equal to qiskit QFTGate(5).inverse() with identity qubit map, i.e. the opposite sign/bit-order convention); all fitted angles are multiples of pi/32: RZ/RX in QASM order = pi/32 * [1,-30,4,-24,16,16,33,-30,4,8,-16,1,-30,4,-24,-16,34,4,8,16,36,-24,-24,-16,48]. Final QASM keeps pseudo-random angles | counts: CNOT count 24 = 2*n(n-1)/2 DCNOT-CNOTs + (n-1) decoding CNOTs, matching the paper's n(n-1)/2 + (n-1) two-qubit-gate accounting for n=5

title: Quantum Circuit and Tensor Network Implementation of the 2D Acoustic Wave Equation
description_zh: 在 3 个比特上实现循环移位算符 S⁺ 的增量线路：依次用 Toffoli、CNOT 和 X 从最高位到最低位实现 |x⟩→|x+1 mod 8⟩，用于声波方程有限差分格式中的离散拉普拉斯算符。
description_en: Increment circuit implementing the cyclic shift operator S⁺ on 3 qubits: a Toffoli, a CNOT and an X, applied from the most to the least significant bit, realise |x⟩→|x+1 mod 8⟩; used for the discrete Laplacian in the finite-difference scheme of the acoustic wave equation.
verification: functional: unitary equals the cyclic permutation |x> -> |(x+1) mod 8> with q0 = LSB, exactly as stated

title: Granthi: Higher-Order Quantum Programming via Unitary Wiring
description_zh: Granthi 编译器为相干量子开关生成的 6 比特布线线路：以 q4 上的布尔标签为控制，用 4 个 Fredkin 门把载荷 q5 按 b=0 时先 g 后 f、b=1 时先 f 后 g 的顺序接入 f、g 的边界线。
description_en: 6-qubit wiring circuit generated by the Granthi compiler for the coherent quantum switch: controlled by the Boolean label on q4, 4 Fredkin gates route the payload q5 through the boundary wires of f and g in the order g then f for b=0, and f then g for b=1.
verification: functional: the operator is a permutation that preserves the tag. b=0 gives wire map (q0 q2)(q1 q5); b=1 gives the 3-cycle q5->q1->q3->q5. So the two tag sectors route the payload through the boundaries in different orders, as the caption says. counts: 4 Fredkin + 2 X, as drawn

title: Gate-level Implementation and Resource Analysis of Lackadaisical Quantum Walk Search
description_zh: 在 3 比特位置寄存器上实现由硬币比特控制的循环加一（移位算符 S+）：硬币为 |1> 时依次用 C³X、C²X、CX 将位置 x 映射到 x+1 mod 8。
description_en: Coin-controlled cyclic increment (shift operator S+) on a 3-qubit position register: when the coin is |1>, C³X, C²X and CX gates in turn map position x to x+1 mod 8.
verification: functional: for all 8 positions x and coin c, maps |x,c=1> -> |x+1 mod 8,1> (q0 = LSB) and leaves c=0 unchanged (exact permutation check)

title: A 12-CNOT Double Qubit Excitation Gate
description_zh: 本文提出的 CNOT 深度 7 的 12-CNOT 双激发门变体，输出比特按 (q_i,q_j,q_k,q_l)→(q_k,q_l,q_i,q_j) 重新标记。
description_en: The CNOT-depth-7 variant of the 12-CNOT double-excitation gate proposed in the paper, with the output qubits relabelled as (q_i,q_j,q_k,q_l)→(q_k,q_l,q_i,q_j).
verification: functional: after the stated output permutation (i,j,k,l)->(k,l,i,j), Operator equals the Eq. 2 Givens rotation exactly (error 0, global phase 1) | counts: 12 CX, CX-depth 7, 13 merged 1q gates, depth 15, matching the table

title: A 12-CNOT Double Qubit Excitation Gate
description_zh: 本文提出的 12-CNOT 双量子比特激发门分解（CNOT 深度 8），在 |0011⟩ 与 |1100⟩ 之间实现角度 θ 的 Givens 旋转。
description_en: The 12-CNOT decomposition of the double-qubit excitation gate proposed in the paper (CNOT depth 8), implementing a Givens rotation by angle θ between |0011⟩ and |1100⟩.
verification: functional: Operator equals Eq. 2 exactly (global phase 1): cos/sin rotation between |q_i q_j q_k q_l>=|0011> and |1100>, identity elsewhere; error 0 at theta=-2.079028 | counts: 12 CX, CX-depth 8, 13 merged 1q gates, depth 15, matching Table tab:double-excitation-comparison

title: A 12-CNOT Double Qubit Excitation Gate
description_zh: 双量子比特激发算符的高层实现：先用 3 个 CNOT 做基变换，再施加以 q_j,q_k,q_l 为控制、作用在 q_i 上的三控 R_y(2θ) 旋转，最后用镜像 CNOT 还原，实现 |0011⟩ 与 |1100⟩ 之间的转动。
description_en: High-level implementation of the double-qubit excitation operator: 3 CNOTs perform a basis change, a triply controlled R_y(2θ) rotation with controls q_j,q_k,q_l acts on q_i, and mirrored CNOTs restore the basis, implementing a rotation between |0011⟩ and |1100⟩.
params_source: pseudo-random (paper gives none; theta is a free excitation angle)
verification: functional: U|0011> = cos(theta)|0011> + sin(theta)|1100>, U|1100> = cos(theta)|1100> - sin(theta)|0011>, and all other basis states are fixed, as in Eq. (2) (ordering |q_i q_j q_k q_l>). The full unitary also equals exp[-i theta/8 (XYXX+YXXX+YYYX+YYXY-XXYX-XXXY-YXYY-XYYY)] of Eq. (1) up to global phase (fidelity 1.0)

title: Quantum Uncomputation of Clean and Dirty Ancilla Qubits
description_zh: 由自动反计算编译得到的 HighestBitConstAdder 线路：用 2 个脏辅助比特 a₀,a₁ 计算 x₃ ← x₃⊕x₂⊕x₀x₁⊕x₀x₁x₂，随后的 Toffoli/CNOT 序列把脏辅助比特恢复为原值。
description_en: HighestBitConstAdder circuit obtained by automatic uncomputation compilation: using 2 dirty ancillas a₀,a₁ it computes x₃ ← x₃⊕x₂⊕x₀x₁⊕x₀x₁x₂, and the subsequent Toffoli/CNOT sequence restores the dirty ancillas to their original values.
verification: functional: permutation check over all 64 basis inputs: x3 -> x3 xor x2 xor x0x1 xor x0x1x2, x0..x2 unchanged, and both dirty ancillas restored to their arbitrary initial values.

title: Quantum Uncomputation of Clean and Dirty Ancilla Qubits
description_zh: 使用 3 个脏辅助比特 a₀,a₁,a₂ 计算 4 比特整数 x 加常数 (1010)₂（x₀ 为最低位）后的最高位并写入 x₃ 的线路（无反计算）：x₃ ← x₃⊕x₂⊕x₀x₁⊕x₀x₁x₂。
description_en: Circuit that uses 3 dirty ancillas a₀,a₁,a₂ to compute the highest bit of the 4-bit integer x plus the constant (1010)₂ (x₀ is the least significant bit) and writes it into x₃ (without uncomputation): x₃ ← x₃⊕x₂⊕x₀x₁⊕x₀x₁x₂.
verification: functional: permutation check over all 128 basis inputs: x0,x1,x2 unchanged and x3 -> x3 xor x2 xor x0x1 xor x0x1x2 (the stated MSB function) for every value of the dirty ancillas (ancillas not restored, as caption says 'without uncomputation').

title: Quantum Uncomputation of Clean and Dirty Ancilla Qubits
description_zh: 用 2 个脏辅助比特 a₀、a₂ 和 1 个干净辅助比特 a₁ 实现的 5 控制 H 门（MCH）线路：由 Toffoli 级联把 A∧B∧C 写入 a₁，再用两次受控受控 H（CCH）与 Toffoli 夹逼使 T 上仅当 A∧B∧C∧D∧E 时作用 H（不做反计算）。
description_en: 5-controlled H gate (MCH) built with 2 dirty ancillas a₀, a₂ and 1 clean ancilla a₁: a Toffoli cascade writes A∧B∧C into a₁, then two doubly controlled H (CCH) gates interleaved with Toffolis apply H to T only when A∧B∧C∧D∧E holds (no uncomputation).
verification: functional: over all 256 basis settings of A..E,a0,a2 with a1=|0>, T receives H iff A&B&C&D&E and A..E are unchanged, for arbitrary dirty a0,a2 (Operator check).

title: Gate-based emulation of boson sampling using photonic qubits
description_zh: 在 4 个比特（两个模式各用 2 比特 Gray 码表示 0–3 个光子）上实现三光子玻色采样中单个 50:50 分束器的重复单元：先把 Gray 码转换为按光子数分区的编码，施加含 Z、R_y(2π/3)、受控 H 的分束器变换，再转换回 Gray 码。
description_en: Repeating unit of a single 50:50 beam splitter in three-photon boson sampling on 4 qubits (each of the two modes uses a 2-qubit Gray code for 0–3 photons): the Gray code is first converted into an encoding partitioned by photon number, the beam-splitter transformation containing Z, R_y(2π/3) and controlled-H gates is applied, and the encoding is converted back to Gray code.
verification: functional: for all 10 two-mode Fock states with n1+n2<=3 (Gray code 0->00,1->10,2->11,3->01 per mode), output equals the 50:50 beam-splitter evolution (a1†->(a1†+a2†)/√2, a2†->(a1†-a2†)/√2), max 1-|overlap| 1.4e-15, consistent phase within each photon-number sector

title: Gate-based emulation of boson sampling using photonic qubits
description_zh: 在 4 个比特（3 个路径比特 + 1 个偏振比特）上实现针对输入 |1010> 的四模式两光子干涉仪简化线路：通过 X、H、CNOT、Toffoli 与受控 H 门直接产生对应的玻色采样输出分布。
description_en: Simplified circuit for a four-mode two-photon interferometer with input |1010> on 4 qubits (3 path qubits + 1 polarisation qubit): X, H, CNOT, Toffoli and controlled-H gates directly produce the corresponding boson-sampling output distribution.
verification: functional: starting from |1010> (the input labelled on the wires), output probabilities 0.25 on |1001> and 0.125 on |0010>,|0011>,|0100>,|0101>,|1010>,|1100>, identical to the linear-optics two-photon output distribution of the interferometer under the paper's encoding

title: Gate-based emulation of boson sampling using photonic qubits
description_zh: 在 5 个比特（4 个模式比特 + 1 个辅助比特）上模拟两光子四模式玻色采样干涉仪（分束器 B12、B34 后接 B23）：每个分束器由反控 Toffoli 识别旁观模式为空后、在两模式比特上施加编码的两光子分束器单元，再反算辅助比特。
description_en: Emulates a two-photon four-mode boson-sampling interferometer (beam splitters B12, B34 followed by B23) on 5 qubits (4 mode qubits + 1 ancilla): for each beam splitter, an anti-controlled Toffoli detects that the spectator modes are empty, the encoded two-photon beam-splitter unit is applied to the two mode qubits, and the ancilla is uncomputed.
verification: functional: on all 10 encoded two-photon Fock inputs (ancilla |0>), the circuit's output equals the linear-optics evolution B23·(B12⊗B34) under the paper's encoding (|2000>->1000, |1010>->1010, ...), max 1-|overlap| 1.8e-15, consistent phase across the sector; ancilla returned to |0>

title: Exact quantum circuits for a lattice Boltzmann realization of the Dirac equation
description_zh: 格点玻尔兹曼 Dirac 方案中的流动（平移）算子：在 3 比特位置寄存器上用多控 X 级联实现 |x⟩→|x+1 mod 8⟩（p0 为最低位）。
description_en: Streaming (shift) operator of the lattice Boltzmann Dirac scheme: a cascade of multi-controlled X gates on a 3-qubit position register implements |x⟩→|x+1 mod 8⟩ (p0 is the least significant bit).
verification: functional: Operator maps |x> -> |x+1 mod 8> for all 8 inputs (p0 = LSB, as the paper states), with uniform phase

title: Separating quantum circuits from classical LLMs
description_zh: 在 5 个系统比特与 4 个辅助比特上的常深度 QNC⁰ 采样线路：H 后用两层 CNOT 将相邻 Z_iZ_{i+1} 宇称写入辅助比特（测量得到穷人猫态），再对系统比特施加 H 并测量，输出为偶宇称均匀分布 U_5^⊕。
description_en: Constant-depth QNC⁰ sampling circuit on 5 system qubits and 4 ancillas: after H, two layers of CNOTs write the neighbouring Z_iZ_{i+1} parities into the ancillas (measuring them yields a poor man's cat state), then H is applied to the system qubits, which are measured; the output is the uniform even-parity distribution U_5^⊕.
verification: functional: marginal on q_1..q_5 is exactly uniform (1/16) over the 16 even-parity strings, odd-parity prob 0 (= U_5^⊕ as stated); ancilla syndromes uniform; depth 4 (H, CX, CX, H) matches 'prepared in depth 4'. Measurements dropped (ancillas idle after measurement, so deferring is exact).

title: Structure-Preserving Quantum Simulation of Wave Equations on a Trapped-Ion Processor
description_zh: 二维声波方程电路中的亮-通量旋转 ℛ_x：以幅值位为控制的单控与双控 R_X 门在场比特 f1 上合成模式相关的角度 β_k=2tΩ_k。
description_en: Bright-flux rotation ℛ_x of the 2D acoustic wave equation circuit: singly and doubly controlled R_X gates, controlled by the magnitude bits, synthesise the mode-dependent angle β_k=2tΩ_k on the field qubit f1.
params_source: paper: Eq. beta-values with N_h = 32 and t = 0.1 (the paper's fixed representative time for resource scans)
verification: functional: for every valid magnitude pair (m_x,m_y) in {0,1,2}^2 the f1 block equals R_X(2t*sqrt(A_mx^2 + A_my^2)) (max err 7e-16), i.e. beta_k = 2t*Omega_k as stated

title: Structure-Preserving Quantum Simulation of Wave Equations on a Trapped-Ion Processor
description_zh: 二维声波方程电路中的 Givens 变换 𝒢：在 f1=0 条件下，用由幅值位控制的（双）控 R_Y 旋转合成与模式相关的角度 α_k，把两个速度分量旋转到亮-暗基。
description_en: Givens transform 𝒢 of the 2D acoustic wave equation circuit: conditioned on f1=0, (doubly) controlled R_Y rotations controlled by the magnitude bits synthesise the mode-dependent angle α_k and rotate the two velocity components into the bright–dark basis.
params_source: paper: gamma = arctan(A_1/A_2), A_m = 2 N_h sin(pi m/N_h), N_h = 32
verification: functional: for every valid magnitude pair (m_x,m_y) in {0,1,2}^2 the f0 block is R_Y(alpha_k) when f1=0 and identity when f1=1 (max err 2e-15), with alpha_k matching the table alpha_10=alpha_20=0, alpha_01=alpha_02=pi, alpha_11=alpha_22=pi/2, alpha_12=pi-2gamma, alpha_21=2gamma and the definition 2*atan2(A_my, A_mx)

title: Structure-Preserving Quantum Simulation of Wave Equations on a Trapped-Ion Processor
description_zh: 二维声波方程傅里叶块电路中的相位变换 𝒫：以场比特 f0,f1 选择 x/y 分量，用由符号位与幅值位控制的多控相位门合成保留模式 k∈{0,±1,±2} 的相位 φ_k。
description_en: Phase transform 𝒫 of the Fourier-block circuit for the 2D acoustic wave equation: the field qubits f0,f1 select the x/y component, and multi-controlled phase gates controlled by the sign and magnitude bits synthesise the phases φ_k of the retained modes k∈{0,±1,±2}.
params_source: paper: delta = pi/N_h with N_h = 32 (32x32 grid used in the 2D H2-2 experiments)
verification: functional: unitary is diagonal; phase on every basis state equals exp(i*phi(m0,m1,s)) of Eq. phi-boolean for the x-register when f0=f1=0, for the y-register when f0=1,f1=0, and 1 otherwise (max err 1e-15); retained phases reproduce pi-delta, pi-2delta, 2delta, delta of Eq. phase-values

title: Iterative quantum algorithms for the minimum vertex cover problem based on continuous-time quantum walks
description_zh: 最小顶点覆盖约束量子游走的 p=1 线路（4 顶点示例图）：先用 X 门制备全覆盖态 |1111⟩，再按顶点顺序施加以其全部邻居为控制的多控 RX 旋转，使振幅只在可行顶点覆盖子空间内传播。
description_en: p=1 circuit of the constrained quantum walk for minimum vertex cover (4-vertex example graph): X gates first prepare the full-cover state |1111⟩, then, vertex by vertex, a multi-controlled RX rotation controlled by all of the vertex's neighbours is applied, so that amplitude propagates only within the feasible vertex-cover subspace.
params_source: pseudo-random (paper gives no value for this example). Qiskit Rx angle 2.447614 = paper RX(t)=e^{itX} with t=-1.223807
verification: functional: final statevector equals the paper's quantum-tree formula (amplitude cos t per kept branch, i sin t per removed vertex; overlap 1.0, max diff 7e-16). Support lies exactly on the 6 feasible vertex covers {1111,0111,1011,1101,1110,1001}, with zero weight outside the VC subspace

title: Designing tight frames for quantum computing
description_zh: 用 2 个辅助比特通过 Naimark 扩张实现单比特 C_4 调和紧框架 POVM E_k 的线路：先作置换 P_σ=CNOT(ρ→a₁)，再对 3 比特施加量子傅里叶变换 F_8（H、受控 S/T 与 SWAP），测量辅助比特得到 k=2i+j。
description_en: Circuit realising the single-qubit C_4 harmonic tight-frame POVM E_k by Naimark dilation with 2 ancillas: first the permutation P_σ=CNOT(ρ→a₁), then the quantum Fourier transform F_8 on the 3 qubits (H, controlled S/T and SWAP); measuring the ancillas yields k=2i+j.
verification: functional: for random 1-qubit rho with ancillas |00>, outcome probabilities of measured wires (i,j) equal Tr(E_k rho) with k=2i+j for E_k = (1/4)[[1,w^-k],[w^k,1]], w=i (eq. 3.61), all 4 outcomes match to 1e-6.

title: An Analytically Trained Variational Surrogate for Quantum Phase Estimation on NISQ Hardware
description_zh: 在 4 个比特上构造 QPE 替代用变分量子线路（p=1 层）：每个比特施加 R_Y、R_Z 旋转，随后在所有 6 对比特间施加 CZ（全连接纠缠层），最后再施加一层 R_Y、R_Z 旋转。
description_en: Variational quantum circuit (p=1 layer) used as a QPE surrogate on 4 qubits: R_Y and R_Z rotations on each qubit, followed by CZ on all 6 qubit pairs (fully connected entangling layer), and finally another layer of R_Y and R_Z rotations.
params_source: pseudo-random (paper gives no trained parameter values)
verification: counts: 16 rotations = 2(p+1)n_a = 2·2·4 parameters as stated, 6 CZ = all n_a(n_a-1)/2 pairs of the full entangler; gate-by-gate faithfulness checked (final measurements dropped)

title: Identity-Paired Progressive Depth Training: When Trainability Persists Beyond Expressibility
description_zh: 4 比特、2 层的标准硬件高效拟设（HEA）：每层先对每个比特施加 R_Y、R_Z、R_X 三个参数化旋转，再施加 1→2→3→4→1 的环形 CNOT 纠缠层。
description_en: Standard 4-qubit, 2-layer hardware-efficient ansatz (HEA): each layer applies the three parameterised rotations R_Y, R_Z, R_X to every qubit, followed by a ring CNOT entangling layer 1→2→3→4→1.
params_source: pseudo-random (paper gives none; 24 variational angles \vartheta_anon0..23 as in cands.jsonl)
verification: counts: 3nD = 24 rotations and nD = 8 CNOTs for n=4, D=2, matching the paper's parameter dimension 3nD (Eq. hea_circuit). The rest is a gate-by-gate faithfulness check (rotation order Y,Z,X per Eq. hea_block; ring order)

title: The Time-Space Complexity of Checking Multiple Assertions in Quantum Programs
description_zh: 在 4 个比特（1 个 fail 标志 + 3 比特索引寄存器）上实现断言检查中的受控换位 V³_Tran：沿 Gray 路径用三个多控非门（G1 G2 G1 回文序列），在 fail=1 时交换索引态 |000> 与 |011>，其余基态保持不变。
description_en: Controlled transposition V³_Tran for assertion checking on 4 qubits (1 fail flag + a 3-qubit index register): three multi-controlled NOT gates along a Gray path (the palindromic sequence G1 G2 G1) swap the index states |000> and |011> when fail=1, leaving all other basis states unchanged.
verification: functional: exact permutation check — with fail=1 swaps idx |000> <-> |011> (idx1 idx2 idx3) and fixes all other 14 basis states; identity when fail=0

title: GPU-Accelerated Host-Aware Dead-Measurement Detection in Hybrid Quantum--Classical Programs: Full Version
description_zh: 论文的 VQE 型诊断工作负载量子核：4 比特上先用 3 个 Toffoli 构成固定纠缠骨架，再施加 R_z/R_y 单比特旋转层（角度 0 或 π/4），最后用 CZ、CNOT 与 Toffoli 组成关联层。
description_en: Quantum kernel of the paper's VQE-style diagnostic workload: on 4 qubits, 3 Toffolis form a fixed entangling backbone, followed by a layer of R_z/R_y single-qubit rotations (angles 0 or π/4), and finally a correlation layer of CZ, CNOT and Toffoli gates.
params_source: paper: angles given explicitly in the diagram (0, pi/4)
verification: counts: the paper's original-circuit metrics (#1q, #2q, depth) = (82, 26, 61) are reproduced exactly by qiskit transpile (opt level 0) to {rz, sx, x, cx} when the drawn Rz(0)/Ry(0) gates are kept. The final QASM omits those identities, which gives (75, 26, 55); the 2q count of 26 matches

title: Entanglement as a Structural Complexity Axis: A PAC-Bayesian View of Generalization in Quantum Policies and Value Functions
description_zh: 4 比特参数化量子线路的一层（全连接版本）：先用 R_Y(x_i) 角度编码输入，再对每个比特施加可训练的 R_Y、R_Z，随后施加全部 6 个两两 CNOT（全对全纠缠块），最后读出 ⟨Z_0⟩。
description_en: One layer (fully connected version) of a 4-qubit parameterised quantum circuit: R_Y(x_i) angle encoding of the inputs, trainable R_Y and R_Z on every qubit, then all 6 pairwise CNOTs (all-to-all entangling block), with ⟨Z_0⟩ read out at the end.
params_source: pseudo-random (paper gives none; angle-less R_Y/R_Z boxes are the data encoding R_Y(x_i) and trainable angles)
verification: faithfulness only (gate-by-gate: 4 encoding R_Y + 4 R_Y + 4 R_Z, CNOTs 0->1,0->2,0->3,1->2,1->3,2->3 in diagram order); counts: 6 CNOTs = n(n-1)/2 all-to-all for n=4 and 2n=8 trainable rotations per layer (d=2nL) as stated.

title: Non-Clifford Benchmarking via Ensemble Feature Selection
description_zh: 在 3 个比特线性拓扑上实现经由中间路由比特 q1 的 CZ(0,2)：由 12 个 √X 与 7 个原生 CZ 组成（深度 13）的转译线路，用作 EFS 估计器的 Clifford 验证基准。
description_en: CZ(0,2) on a 3-qubit linear topology, routed through the middle qubit q1: a transpiled circuit of 12 √X and 7 native CZ gates (depth 13), used as a Clifford validation benchmark for the EFS estimator.
verification: functional: Operator equals CZ(q0,q2)⊗I(q1) up to global phase; counts: 12 √X (rx(pi/2)) and 7 CZ, depth 13 — exactly as stated in the caption
